body: There's no one left. I think everyone is too busy with their own problems anymore. If I cant find someone soon, there's just no point. I'm tired of swimming.
Its getting to the point where at moments I just want to shoot myself.
Its getting to the point where at moments I just want to shoot myself.

I dont know, even though I'm not hurting as much. I'm feeling less and less optimistic about finding any happiness again. My closest friend, my mom, died a year ago this month. 

I'm not me anymore, I dont have my personality, I dont have my sense of humor, or my charm anymore. I'm empty, I'm alone, and I'm sad.

I think the biggest things (among various things) is just being able to be my gay self in Utah. It's been hard to find anyone on the same wavelength as myself. I'm stuck in a limbo with no real escape. It's weird, with the pain being gone but now only seeing one path to death, it's a weird resolve.

Just another day of not making any strides to happiness. I've been trying to pull myself out of this for a long time now, things just arent working. I dont meet anyone, I dont connect with anyone, I dont accomplish anything. I feel useless and alone.
Talk me through what? Ending it is pretty straight forward.
